name: OpenDesign
description: Create and revise interactive HTML designs in Cindy, with session-owned preview cards, element comments, manual editing and drawing annotations.
whenToUse: Use for OpenDesign HTML designs. Continue the current manuscript with opendesign_context then opendesign_update. Cards open the owning session sidebar. Explicit viewer submissions continue that same Cindy session; no separate chat or errands.

opendesign_new.description: Create the first HTML manuscript in this tool call’s session and return a preview card. Writes a dedicated local project; does not create/switch sessions or call a model. Use context/update for existing manuscripts.

opendesign_context.description: Read the current session manuscript, revision, sketches, comments and screenshot paths before editing. Treat historical feedback as context. Does not open a window.

opendesign_update.description: Write complete HTML back to the same session manuscript with expectedRevision from context. Backs up prior HTML, rejects conflicts, and returns a new preview card. Does not create sessions or open windows.

opendesign_open.description: Return a clickable card for the current manuscript. Clicking opens it in the owning session sidebar. file selects the initial HTML only when adopting an older project.

opendesign_preview.description: Same as opendesign_open: return a manuscript preview card without automatically opening a window.
